Proverbs (Famous)

Cervantes.
A baker’s dozen.
Rabelais.
A cat may look at a king.

Swift.

Herbert.

A happy accident.

Cervantes.
All’s well that ends well.
Shakespeare.
Although the last, not least.
Shakespeare.

H. A. Page.

Benj. Franklin.

Publius Syrus.
As busie as a bee.
Lyly.
As sure as a gun.
Dryden.
As you sow, y’ are like to reap.
Butler.

Heywood.

Shakespeare.

Burton.

Shakespeare.
Better late than never.

Camden.

Burton.

Camden.

Scott.

Shakespeare.

Eureka! Eureka!

Publius Syrus.

Swift.

Scott.

Hail, fellow, well met.

Have yee him on the hip?

He that has two strings t’ his bow.

Cervantes.

Shakespeare.

Shakespeare.

Shakespeare.

Herbert.

Butler.

Burton.
Mad as a March hare.

Heywood.

Burton.

Rabelais.

Byron.

Thos. Southerne.

Geo. Colman (the Younger).

R. H. Barham.

Heywood.

Heywood.

Pittacus.

Smell a rat.
Cervantes.
